description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling 'ModifyFeatureProperty' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically modifying or creating feature properties of 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles modification or creation of feature properties in 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method to process the 'ModifyFeatureProperty' command, removing existing property, validating size, and determining whether to modify or create a feature property.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts a specific feature from a 'Thing' based on the command's feature ID.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing feature property or create a new one based on feature properties.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a result for modifying an existing feature property.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a result for creating a new feature property.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' state for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the new 'Thing' state after modification.
